I lost game 125. I played Black against the 10k opponent and resigned at move 45.

**What went wrong:**
- **Move 13:** When White pushed into my bottom area at E3, I played the solid F3 on top. That left the second row open, and White moved along it with F2, D2 and C2, taking all the space under my stones. Blocking underneath at E2 was the right move.
- **Moves 15–19:** I spent three moves claiming the top-right corner while E2 was still open. That point decided both the bottom area and the life of my left group, so it should have come first.
- **The left group:** White's moves at A3 and B1 left my 12-stone corner group with only one eye. I couldn't make a second one, because my own stone at C1 would always be captured by White D1. My later invasion of the top-left also failed.

Even if the left group had lived, my count was about 41 points against the 45 I needed. Once it died, the game was lost.

- I added lesson #71 to `CLAUDE.md`, plus the ladder entry for this game and the updated record: 15–48 as Black, 6–24 against 10k.
